budget_ms._comment: Budget for gate path [sys.executable, script] — no shell, real Python. During active OneDrive sync + Defender scanning, startup alone consumes 1700ms+. Values are p90 syncing-state gate-path totals observed 2026-09-23. Production path (shell=True) runs 1.8x slower — see FACTS.md §11.

_comment_interpreter_floor: Measured 2026-09-23 on Windows 11 / OneDrive (<org>) / Python 3.14.3. Method: subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-c', 'pass']). States: (1) quiet/idle: p50=534ms. (2) active OneDrive sync: p50=1707ms. (3) OneDrive paused (sync paused from tray): p50=1333ms — filter driver overhead persists even when sync is paused, because the driver intercepts file reads regardless of sync state. Running hook scripts from OneDrive costs ~5s additional when Defender scans the script file on first read — 6580ms gate-path vs 1333ms floor. Defender path exclusions (hooks-dir + Lib) reduce this to 1132ms during active sync (-37%). See FACTS.md §11.
_comment_kill_switch_headroom: Added to interpreter_floor_ms to get kill_threshold. 800ms covers stdlib imports (json/os/sys) plus Defender scan headroom. Total: floor(1700) + headroom(800) = 2500ms.
_comment_daemon_trigger: Thresholds for the Phase 4 daemon (pre-warmed Python process). spawn_warn_ms and spawn_daemon_ms are checked by 'doctor' via subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-c', 'pass']) x5; use p50. duration_warn_ms checks hook_log.duration_ms (within-Python time only — does NOT include spawn). min_hook_events: don't trigger recommendations until this many real hook_log entries exist.

daemon_trigger._comment_spawn_warn: p50 spawn floor above this → recommend Defender path exclusions. Rationale: 1000ms is well above quiet-state (534ms) but below active-sync-with-Defender (1700ms). Persistent elevation above 1000ms means something is adding overhead.
daemon_trigger._comment_spawn_daemon: p50 spawn floor above this → recommend daemon. Rationale: 2500ms = interpreter_floor + kill_switch_headroom. If every spawn costs this much, spawning is the dominant cost and a pre-warmed process eliminates it.
daemon_trigger._comment_duration_warn: hook_log.duration_ms p50 above this → DB or retrieval is unusually slow (separate from spawn cost). Normal within-Python work is 50-100ms; 200ms suggests a problem.
daemon_trigger._comment_min_events: Minimum hook_log entries before any recommendation fires. Avoids triggering on cold-start outliers.
